correctness.rationale: In \(2\times2\), one-sided diagonal scaling reduces to one positive ratio \(t\), and \(K+K^{-1}=\|A_t\|_F^2/|\det A_t|\) gives a unique row-equilibrating minimum. The row-correlation formula follows from \((ab-c^2)^2=r_1^2r_2^2-c^2(a+b)^2\). For Gaussian initialization in any \(d\ge2\), a fixed null direction of one row bounds \(\sigma_{\min}\) while that row norm grows like \(1/|g_1|\); positivity of the nonsingular Gaussian density on a box gives a logarithmically divergent expectation.

value.rationale: The source diagnostic explicitly averages empirical conditioning behavior under Gaussian initialization and identifies lower bounds as an open direction. Showing that its unregularized condition number has an infinite population mean is therefore a substantive diagnostic fact: mean-based summaries have no finite population target. The sharp two-dimensional floor additionally isolates orientation as an exact obstruction, with a rotated spectrum for which no initialization can improve conditioning at all.
